PraisonAIUI has full Python ↔ YAML ↔ CLI parity—you can declare chat apps, UI component pages, live A2UI surfaces, notifications, and static docs sites directly in YAML without writing Python.

Run any folder in examples/yaml/ with aiui run chat.yaml: Example What it demonstrates Run 01-chat Minimal zero-code YAML chat agent aiui run chat.yaml 02-profiles Multi-persona agent switching via profiles: aiui run chat.yaml 03-clean-chat Focused sidebar-free chat (dashboard.sidebar: false) aiui run chat.yaml 04-tools Built-in tool registration in YAML aiui run chat.yaml 05-features Feature flags and dashboard options aiui run chat.yaml 13-playground Multi-profile playground (--style agents) aiui run chat.yaml --style agents
Save as app.yaml and run aiui run app.yaml—editing the file updates blocks, badges, and surfaces live without restarting:

Template Focus Run 06-minimal 5-line YAML → static docs site aiui build && aiui serve 07-blocks Component blocks & custom widgets aiui build && aiui serve 08-colorful / 09-corporate / 10-dark-modern Themed documentation layouts aiui build && aiui serve 11-developer-portal / 12-full-featured OpenAPI reference, SEO, i18n, a11y, search aiui build && aiui serve
examples/plugins/aiui-hello-plugin — Complete third-party Python + React plugin package using praisonaiui.plugins entry points and @aiui/sdk. See UI Plugins for the full SDK guide.
